a: Vechi tema hacha name benitarev beachat; i hachi, amar lo rabbi yehoshua: hare hu over al bal tosif – hacha bal tosif mehecha?
Ella amar rava: bevalul la peligi, ki peligi – bechosot; lerabbi eliezer it leh roin, lerabbanan let lehu roin.

Uvevalul la peligi?! vehatanya, amar rabbi yehuda: lo nechleku rabbi eliezer vachachamim al dam chattat shennitarev bedam ola – sheyyikrav, berovea venirba – shello yikrav. al ma nechleku? al dam temima shennitarev bedam baalat mum – sherabbi eliezer omer: yikrav, ben bevalul ben bechosot; vachachamim omrim: lo yikrav.
Rabbi yehuda allibba derabbi eliezer matne ben bevalul ben bechosot, verabbanan bechosot peligi.
Amar abbaye: lo shanu ella techillat chattat veola,
Aval sof chattat [veola] – divre hakkol mekom ola mekom shirayim. amar leh rav yosef, hachi amar rav yehuda: shirayim tzerichin itzteva.
Vechen amar rabbi shimon: lo shanu ella techillat chattat veola, aval sof chattat veola – divre hakkol mekom ola mekom shirayim. amar rabbi yochanan, veittema rabbi elazar: adayin hi machloket.
Metiv rav huna bar yehuda: "kodesh hem" – sheim nitarev bedam kadashim acherim, yikrevu. may, lav sof ola uvechor – ushema minna mekom ola mekom shirayim? la; techillat ola uvechor.
Umay ka mashma lan, deen olin mevattelim ze et ze? hay mivvelakach middam happar umiddam hassair" nafka! tannae hi; ikka denafka leh mehacha, veikka denafka leh mehacha.
Metiv rava: "vehikrivu bene aharon et haddam vezarku et haddam" – ma
b: Talmud lomar "dam" "dam"? sheyyachol en li ella ellu shennitarvu bitmuratah, sheaf mechayyim tikrav; minnayin lerabbot toda ushelamim?
Merabbe ani toda ushelamim, shebbain beneder unedava kemotah. minnayin lerabbot et haasham?
Merabbe ani et haasham, shettaun mattan arba kemoto. bechor umaaser vafesach minnayin? talmud lomar "dam" "dam".
May, lav sof ola uvechor – ushema minna: mekom ola mekom shirayim?
La; techillat ola uvechor. umay ka mashma lan – en olin mevattelin ze et ze? mivvelakach middam happar umiddam hassair" nafka! tannae hi; ikka denafka leh mehacha, veikka denafka leh mehacha.
Vehane tannae, mivvelakach middam happar umiddam hassair" la yalfi – kasavri en mearvin likranot; middam" "dam" la yalef – "dam" "dam" la mashma lehu;
Ella mikkodesh hem" – may tama la yalfi? kasavri: "kodesh hem" – hem kerevin, veen temuratan kereva.
Veiddach, nafka leh meim shor im se laAdonai hu" – hu karev, veen temurato kereva.
Ta shema: natan lemala velo nimlach – ellu veellu modim sheyyachazor veyitten lematta, ellu vaellu olin lo.
May, lav deiaruv chattat veola? vechevan deyahev leh lemala, havu lehu shirayim; vekatane: ellu veellu modim sheyyachazor veyitten lematta, ushema minna: mekom ola mekom shirayim!
Ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef, amar: amri bemareva, hacha bemay askinan – kegon deiarav chattat hachitzona beshirayim.
Amar leh abbaye, venema mar: kegon deiarav beshirayim! dilma ha ka mashma lan – afillu leman deamar shirayim meakkevin, chasru en meakkevin.
Amar leh rava tosfaa leravina: ha okemna hahi berubba elyonim, veka yahev lemala shiur tachtonim veod! amar leh: hane mille leman deamru meikkara en billa; massekana – bechosot peligi.
Mishna hannittanin bifnim shennitarvu benittanin bachutz – yishshafchu laamma. natan bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim – kasher.

Bifnim, vechazar venatan bachutz – rabbi akiva posel, vachachamim machshirim. sherabbi akiva omer: kol damim shennichnesu lechapper bahechol – pesulin, vachachamim omrim: chattat bilvad. rabbi eliezer omer: af haasham, shenneemar: "kachattat kaasham".
Gemara veniflog name rabbi eliezer beha!
Hechi lebed? nittev bachutz vahadar nittev lifnim? keshem shemmitzva lehakedim elyonim lattachtonim, kach mitzva lehakedim penim lachutz.

a: Venittev lefanim vahadar nittev lachutz? kevan deikka chattat veasham dechi nichnas daman pesulin, la pesika leh.

Shehaya rabbi akiva omer [vechulei]. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mashal lema haddavar dome? letalmid shemmazag lerabbo bechammin, veamar lo: mezog li. amar lo: bamme? amar lo: lo bechammin anu asukin achshav?! ben bechammin ben betzonen.
Hacha name – mikkedi bechattat askinan veate, "chattat" dichtav rachamana lema li? ella lav chattat kaamena la, ella kol kadashim.
Matkef la rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: mikkede itrabbo kol kadashim legabbe mizbeach leinyan merika ushetifa, "chattat" dichtav rachamana lema li? shema minna: chattat in, midde acharina la.
Veha la damya ella letalmid shemmazag lerabbo ben bechammin ben betzonen, amar lo: al timzog li ella chammin!

Ella tama derabbi akiva mechattat" "vechol chattat"; detanya: "chattat" – en li ella chattat; kodshe kadashim minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol chattat". kadashim kallim minnayin? talmud lomar: "vechol chattat". divre rabbi akiva.

Amar lo rabbi yose haggelili: afillu atta merabbe kol hayyom kullo, eni shomea lecha ella chattat. en li ella chattat yachid, chattat tzibbur minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol chattat". veen li ella chattat zachar, chattat nekeva minnayin? talmud lomar: "vechol".
Kelappe leyay? ella hachi kaamar: en li ella chattat nekeva, chattat zachar minnayin? talmud lomar: "vechol chattat".
Vesavar rabbi yose haggelili: hay kera lehachi hu daata?! vehatanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: (lefi shemmatzinu) kol hainyan kullo eno medabber ella befarim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim –
Lisrof pesulehen abbet habbira, velaamod belo taase al achilato.
Amru lo: chattat shennichnas damah lifnay velifnim – minnayin? amar lahem: "hen lo huva".
Lidvarav derabbi akiva kaamar.
Mishna chattat shekkibbel dama bishne kosot, yatza echad mehen lachutz – happenimi kasher. nichnas echad mehem lifnim – rabbi yose haggelili machshir bachitzon, vachachamim poslin.
Amar rabbi yose haggelili: ma im bemakom shehammachshava poselet bachutz – lo asa et hameshuyyar kayyotze, makom sheen hammachshava poselet bifnim – eno din shello naase et hameshuyyar kannichnas?!
Nichnas lechapper, af al pi shello kipper – pasul. divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi shimon omer: ad sheyyechapper. rabbi yehuda omer: im hichnis shogeg – kasher.
Kol haddamim pesulin shennetano al gabbe hammizbeach – lo hirtza hatztzitz ella al hattame. shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame, veeno meratztze al hayyotze.

Gemara tanya: amar rabbi yose haggelili, kal vachomer: uma bimkom shemmachshava poselet, bachutz – lo pasal dam shebbachutz et shebbifnim; mekom sheen machshava poselet, bifnim – eno din shello yifsol dam shebbifnim et shebbachutz?
Amru lo: hare hu omer "asher yuva middamah" – afillu miktzat damah.

Amar lahem, kal vachomer layyotze meatta: uma bimkom sheen machshava poselet, bifnim – posel dam shebbifnim et shebbachutz; mekom shemmachshava poselet, bachutz – eno din sheyyifsol dam shebbachutz et shebbifnim?
Amru lo: hare hu omer "asher yuva" – hannichnas posel veen hayyotze posel.

Utehe machshava bifnim poselet mikkal vechomer: uma bimkom shello pasal dam shebbachutz et shebbifnim – machshava poselet bachutz, mekom sheppasal dam shebbifnim et dam shebbachutz – eno din shettehe machshava poselet bifnim?
Hare hu omer: "bayyom hashshelishi" –
b: Makom sheyyehe meshullash bedam, bevasar, beemurim.

Velo tehe machshava poselet bachutz mikkal vachomer: uma mekom sheppasal dam shebbifnim et shebbachutz – en machshava poselet bifnim, mekom shello pasal dam shebbachutz et shebbefanim – eno din shello yehe posel machshava bachutz?
Talmud lomar: "shelishi" – chutz lizmanno, "piggul" – chutz limkomo.
Basar [hayyotze lachutz – pasul], hannichnas lifnim – kasher.

Sheyyehe baddin sheppasul: uma bimkom shello pasal dam shebbachutz et shebbifnim – basar hayyotze lachutz pasul, mekom sheppasal dam shebbifnim et shebbachutz – basar hannichnas bifnim eno din sheyyifsol?
Hare hu omer: "middamah" – damah velo (basar) [besarah].

Kal vachomer meatta: uma bimkom sheppasal dam shebbifnim et shebbachutz – basar hannichnas lefanim kasher; makom shello pasal dam shebbachutz et shebbifnim – basar hayyotze lachutz eno din shekkasher?!
Hare hu omer: "uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu" – kevan sheyyatza basar chutz limchitzato, neesar.
Tanu rabbanan: "penima" – en li ella penima, hechol minnayin? talmud lomar: "el hakkodesh penima".
Veyomar "kodesh", veal veyomar "penima"! amar rava: ba ze velimmed al ze; midde dehave attoshav vesachir".
Detanya: "toshav" – ze kanuy kinyan olam, "sachir" – ze kanuy kinyan shanim.
Yomar "toshav" veal yomar "sachir", vaani omer: kanuy kinyan olam eno ochel, kanuy kinyan shanim lo kol shekken?
Illu ken, hayiti omer: "toshav" – ze kanuy kinyan shanim, aval kenuy kinyan olam yehe ochel; ba "sachir" velimmed al "toshav", shezze kanuy kinyan olam veze kanuy kinyan shanim – veeno ochel.

Amar leh abbaye: bishlama hatam – tere gufe ninhu; veaf al gav dahava leh likra lemichtav "nirtza lo yochal", veiddach ate bekal vachomer – milleta deatya bekal vachomer tarach vechatav la kera. ella hacha, kevan (deikka) deippesel behechol, (hacha) lifnay velifnim may bae?
Ella amar abbaye: lo nitzrecha ella lederech meshuppash. amar leh rava: veha havaa ketiv beh! ella amar rava: kol midde dechashshev aleh lifnay velifnim – la mippesel behechol.
Bae rava: par helem davar shel tzibbur useir avoda zara, shehichnis daman lifnay velifnim – mahu?
Mi amrinan: "el hakkodesh penima" – kol hecha dekarenan "el hakkodesh" karenan leh "penima", kol hecha dela karenan "el hakkodesh" la karenan "penima"; o dilma shello bimkoman hu?
Veim timtze lomar shello bimkoman hu – par vesair shel yom hakkippurim shehizza middaman al habbaddim, vehotzian lahechol vehichnisan, mahu?
Mi amrinan mekoman hu, o dilma hoil unefak nefak?
Veim timtze lomar hoil unefak nefak – hizza middaman al happarochet,

a: Vehotzio lammizbeach vehichnisan, mahu?
Hacha vadday chad makom hu, o [dilma] yetzia karena beh? teku.
Nichnas lechapper. tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: neemar kan "lechapper bakkodesh", veneemar lehallan "vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed bevoo lechapper bakkodesh";
Ma lehallan beshello kipper, af kan beshello kipper.
Rabbi shimon omer: neemar kan "lechapper", veneemar lehallan "veet par hachattat veet seir hachattat asher huva et damam lechapper"; ma lehallan beshekkipper, af kan beshekkipper.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: danin chutz michutz, veen danin chutz mibbifnim;
Umar savar: danin behema mibbehema, veen danin behema meadam.
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. ha mezid – pasul; beshekkipper o beshello kipper?
Amar rabbi yirmeya: mimmashma shenneemar "veet par hachattat veet seir hachattat asher huva et damam (el ohel moed) lechapper bakkodesh" – ma talmud lomar "vehassoref"?
Ma talmud lomar "vehassoref"?! legufeh itzterich! ella ma talmud lomar "chattat" "chattat"?
Lefi shello lamadnu ella lefar vesair shel yom hakkippurim shennisrafin abbet haddeshen – metammein begadim; shear nisrafin minnayin? talmud lomar "chattat" "chattat". divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi meir omer: eno tzarich; hare hu omer: "veet par hachattat veet seir hachattat" – sheen talmud lomar "lechapper", ma talmud lomar "lechapper"? limmed al kol hammitkapperim shehassorfan metamme begadim.
Verabbi yehuda – "lechapper" la mashma leh; may tama? lav mishshum demibbaya leh ligzera shava?
Hadaran alach kol hazzevachim shennitarvu
Mishna hammizbeach mekaddesh [et] harauy lo.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: kol harauy laishshim – im ala lo yered, shenneemar: "hi haola al mokda"; ma ola, shehi reuya laishshim – im alta lo tered; af kol shehu rauy laishshim – im ala lo yered.

Rabban gamliel omer: kol harauy lammizbeach – im ala lo yered, shenneemar: "hi haola al mokda al hammizbeach"; ma ola, shehi reuya lammizbeach – im alta lo tered; af kol davar shehu rauy lammizbeach – im alta lo tered.
En ben divre rabban gamliel ledivre rabbi yehoshua ella haddam vehannesachim – sherabban gamliel omer lo yerdu, verabbi yehoshua omer yerdu.
Rabbi shimon omer: hazzevach kasher unesachim pesulin, hannesachim kesherim vehazzevach pasul, afillu ze vaze pesulin – hazzevach lo yered vehannesachim yerdu.
b: Gemara rauy lo in, sheen rauy lo la; lemaote may? amar rav pappa: lemaote kematzin shello kiddeshu bichli.
Matkef la ravina: may shena middeulla? deamar ulla: emure kadashim kallin sheheelan lifne zerikat daman – lo yerdu, naasu lachmo shel mizbeach.
Hanach la michasseru maase begufayyhu, hane michasseru maase begufayyhu.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: kol harauy laishshim kulei. verabban gamliel name – hachtiv: "ola al mokda"! hahu leahdore pokin hu daata.
Veiddach – leahdore pokin mena leh? nafka leh measher tochal haesh".

Veiddach – hahu mibbee leh: leikkule ola atta machazir, vei atta machazir ikkule ketoret. detane rabbi chanina bar minyome berabbi eliezer ben yaakov: "asher tochal haesh et haola al hammizbeach" – ikkule ola atta machazir, vei atta machazir ikkule ketoret.
Veiddach – lav mimmela shamat minna deikkule ola mehadderinan?
Rabban gamliel omer: kol harauy kulei. verabbi yehoshua name, hachtiv "mizbeach"! hahu mibbaya leh: may (tama) kaamar rachamana kol harauy lemokda? mekaddesh mizbeach.
Veiddach – mizbeach acharina ketiv. veiddach – chad lehecha dehayta lah sheat hakkosher, vechad lehecha delo hayta lah sheat hakkosher.
Veiddach – kevan difsulin ninhu verabbinhu rachamana, la shena hayta lo sheat hakkosher la shena lo hayta lo sheat hakkosher.
Rabbi shimon omer: hazzevach kasher kulei. tanya, rabbi shimon omer: "ola" – ma ola habbaa biglal atzmah, af kol habbain biglal atzman; yatzu nesachim habbain biglal zevach.

Rabbi yose haggelili omer: mittoch shenneemar "kol hannogea bammizbeach yikdash" – shomea ani ben rauy uven sheeno rauy; talmud lomar "kevasim" – ma kevasim reuyin, af kol rauy. rabbi akiva omer: "ola" – ma ola reuya, af kol reuya.
May benayyhu? amar rav adda bar ahava: olat haof pesula ikka benayyhu; mar mayyte la meola", umar mayyte la mikkevasim".
Uleman demayyte la mikkevasim" – hachtiv "ola"! i ketiv "kevasim" vela ketiv "ola", hava amena afillu mechayyim; ketav rachamana "ola".
Uleman demayyte leh meola", ha ketiv "kevasim"! i ketiv "ola" vela ketiv "kevasim", hava amena afillu mincha; ketav rachamana "kevasim".
May ikka ben hane tannae lehane tannae dematnitin? amar rav pappa: kematzim shekkadshu bichli ikka benayyhu – letannae didan lo yerdu, letannae dematnita yerdu.
Resh lakish amar: mincha habbaa bifne atzmah – ledivre kullan lo tered, ledivre rabbi yose haggelili verabbi akiva

a: Tered. mincha habbaa im hazzevach – ledivre rabban gamliel verabbi yehoshua lo tered, ledivre kullan tered.
Nesachim habbain bifne atzman – ledivre kullan yerdu, ledivre rabban gamliel verabbi shimon lo yerdu. nesachin habbain im hazzevach – ledivre kullan yerdu, ledivre rabban gamliel lechodeh lo yerdu.
Peshita! mincha habbaa bifne atzmah itztericha leh – vechidrava, deamar rava: mitnaddev adam minchat nesachim bechol yom.
Venashmeinan kidrava! nesachim habbaim im hazzevach itztericha leh – deka makrev lehu limchar uleyoma chara.
Salka datach amena, hoil veamar mar: "minchatam veniskehem" ballayla, "minchatam veniskehem" lemachar – kinsachim habbain bifne atzman damu, umode rabbi shimon delo yerdu; ka mashma lan.
Mishna ellu im alu lo yerdu: hallan, vehayyotze, vehattame, veshennishchat chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damo.

Rabbi yehuda omer: shennishchat ballayla venishpach damah veyatza damah chutz lakkelaim – im alta tered. rabbi shimon omer: lo tered, shehaya pesulo bakkodesh. sherabbi shimon omer: kol sheppesulo bakkodesh – hakkodesh mekabbelo, lo haya pesulo bakkodesh – en hakkodesh mekabbelo.

Veellu shello haya pesulan bakkodesh: harovea, vehannirba, vehammuketze, vehanneevad, vehaetnan, vehammechir, vehakkilayim, vehatterefa, vehayyotze dofen, uvaale mumin. rabbi akiva machshir bevaale mumin. rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer: doche haya abba et baale mumin meal gabbe hammizbeach.

Keshem sheim alu lo yerdu, kach im yerdu lo yaalu. vechullan shealu chayyim lerosh hammizbeach – yerdu. ola shealta chayya lerosh hammizbeach – tered. shechatah berosh hammizbeach – yafshit vinattecheha bimkomah.
Gemara tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: "zot", "hi", "haola" – hare ellu shelosha miutin; perat leshennishchata ballayla, veshennishpach damah, vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim – sheim alta, tered.

Rabbi shimon omer: "ola" – en li ella ola keshera; minnayin lerabbot shennishchata ballayla, veshennishpach damah, vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim, vehallan, vehayyotze, vehattame, veshennishchat chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damo,
Hannittanin lematta shennetanan lemala, ulemala shennetanan lematta, vehannittanin bachutz shennetanan bifnim, bifnim shennetanan bachutz,
Ufesach vechattat sheshshechatan shello lishman – minnayin? talmud lomar: "torat haola" – ribba tora achat lechol haolin, sheim alu lo yerdu.
Yachol sheani merabbe harovea vehannirba, vehammuketze vehanneevad, veetnan umechir, vechilayim uterefa veyotze dofen? talmud lomar: "zot".
Uma raita lerabbot et ellu ulehotzi et ellu? achar sheribba
b: Hakkatuv umiet, merabbe ani et ellu shehaya pesulan bakkodesh, umotzi ani et ellu shello haya pesulan bakkodesh.
Verabbi yehuda mayyte la mehacha: mippene ma amru lan baddam kasher –
Shehare lan kasher baemurin. lan baemurin kasher – shehare lan kasher babbasar.
Yotze – shehayyotze kasher bevama.
Tame – hoil vehuttar laavodat tzibbur.
Chutz lizmanno – hoil umeratztze lefiggulo.
Chutz limkomo – hoil veittakkash lechutz lizmanno.
Shekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damo – behanach pesule dachazo laavodat tzibbur.
Vechi danin davar shello behechshero, middavar shebbehechshero?!
Tanna azzot torat haola" ribba semich leh.
Amar rabbi yochanan: hashshochet behema ballayla bifnim veheela bachutz – chayyayv,

a: Lo tehe pechuta mishshochet bachutz umaale bachutz.
Metiv rav chiyyay bar avin: hashshochet of bifnim umaale bachutz – patur. shochet bachutz umaale bachutz – chayyayv. nema: lo tehe pechuta mishshochet umaale bachutz!
Teyuveta. ibbaet ema: shechitat haof bifnim – miktal katleh.
Amar ulla: emure kadashim kallim sheheelan lifne zerikat daman – lo yerdu, naasu lachmo shel mizbeach.

Amar rabbi zera, af anan name tenena: shennishpach damah, vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim. uma hatam – deim ba lizrok en lo lizrok, amarta: im alu lo yerdu; hacha deim ba lizrok zorek – lo kol shekken?!
Targema akkodshe kadashim.
Hare pesach – dekadashim kallim hu! targema beshello lishman.
Tenan: vechullan shealu chayyin legabbe mizbeach – yerdu. ha shechutin – lo yerdu; may, lav la shena kodshe kadashim la shena kadashim kallim?
La; ha shechutin – mehen yerdu mehen lo yerdu. veha "kullan" katane! "kullam" achayyin.
Peshita! leolam achayyin – uvedukkin shebbaayin; veallibba derabbi akiva, deamar: im alu lo yerdu.

Bemay okemta – bifsulin? ema sefa: vechen ola shealta chayya lerosh hammizbeach – tered, shechatah berosh hammizbeach – yafshit vinatteach bimkomah. vei pesula – bat hefshet venittuach hi?! "venittach otah" amar rachamana, "otah" – keshera vela pesula!
Sefa atan lichshera. umay kamashma lan? deyesh hefshet venittuach berosh hammizbeach.

Uleman deamar en hefshet venittuach berosh hammizbeach, may ikka lememar? hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehayta lo sheat hakkosher venifsela; verabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi, deamar: kevan shennizrak haddam vehuretza basar shaa achat – yafshitenna, veorah lakkohanim.
Veella dekatane: ketzad ose – morid et hakkeravayim lematta umaddichan; lema li?
Hechi naaved? nakrevinhu befirtayyhu?! "hakerivehu na lefechatecha hayirtzecha o hayissa fanecha"!
Anan hachi kaamrinan: maddichan lema li? dei mitreme kohen acharina vela yada – nassekinhu.
b: Vaanan neku nebed lehu lechohanim milleta deatu ba lide takkala?! afillu hachi adifa, shello yehu kodshe shamayim mutalim kinvela.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, bae rabbi yochanan: emure kadashim kallim sheheelan lifne zerikat daman, yerdu o lo yerdu?
Amar leh rabbi amme: vetibbee lach meila! amar leh: meila la kamibbaya li – dizrika hu dekava lehu bimila; ki kamibbaya leh – yerida. ufashet: lo yerdu, veen bahen meila.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak matne hachi: amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, bae rabbi yochanan: emure kadashim kallim sheheelan lifne zerikat daman, yesh bahen meila o la? amar leh rabbi amme: vetibbee lach yerida! amar leh: yerida la ka mibbaya li – denaasu lachmo shel mizbeach; ki kamibbaya li – meila. ufashet hachi: lo yerdu, veen bahen meila.
Veellu lo haya pesulan [vechulei].

Amar rabbi yochanan: lo hichshir rabbi akiva ella bedukkin shebbaayin, hoil uchesherim baofot. vehu shekkadam hekdeshan et muman. umode rabbi akiva beolat nekeva, dichshekkadam mumah lehekdeshah damya.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: yesh nirba baofot, o en nirba baofot? mi amar: "min habbehema" – lehotzi et harovea vehannirba;
Kol hecha deiteh berovea iteh benirba, kol hecha deleteh berovea leteh benirba; o dilma, hare neevda bo avera?
Amar rabba, ta shema: rabbi akiva machshir bevaale mumin. veim ita, nachsher name benirba – hoil vechasher baofot! shema minna.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, af anan name tenena: hannirba, vehammuketze, vehanneevad, veetnan, umechir, vetumetum, veanderoginos – kullan metammein begadim abbet habbelia! shema minna.
Rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim kulei. may ka mashma lan? ibbaet ema: maase ka mashma lan, veibbaet ema: may doche – kilachar yad.
Keshem sheim ala kulei. amar ulla: lo shanu ella shello mashla bahen haur, aval mashla bahen haur – yaalu.

Rav mari matne aresha; rav chanina missura matne assefa: haatzamot vehaggidin vehakkeranayim vehattelafayim, bizman shemmechubbarin – yaalu, pershu – lo yaalu. amar ulla: lo shanu ella shello mashla bahen haur, aval mashla bahen haur – yaalu.
Man dematne assefa – kol shekken aresha; uman dematne aresha – aval assefa, lav bene haketara ninhu.
Mishna veellu im alu yerdu: besar kodshe kadashim, uvesar kadashim kallim, umotar haomer, ushete hallechem, velechem happanim, usheyare menachot, vehakketoret.

Hatztzemer shebberashe chevasim, vesear shebbizkan teyashim, vehaatzamot vehaggidim vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim; bizman shehem mechubbarim – yaalu, shenneemar: "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol". pershu – lo yaalu, shenneemar: "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam".

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha" – lerabbot haatzamot vehaggidim vehakkeranayim vehattelafayim. yachol afillu pershu? talmud lomar: "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam".
I basar vadam,

a: Yachol yachlotz gidin vaatzamot, veyaale basar legabbe mizbeach? talmud lomar: "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol". ha ketzad? mechubbarin – yaalu, pershu – afillu hen berosh hammizbeach, yerdu.
Man tanna deshamat leh deamar: pershu yardu? rabbi hi, detanya: "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha" – lerabbot haatzamot vehaggidin vehakkeranayim vehattelafayim, afillu pershu.
Veella ma ani mekayyem: "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam"? lomar lach: ikkule ola atta machazir, vei atta machazir ikkule gidin vaatzamot.

Rabbi omer, katuv echad omer: "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha" – ribba, vechatuv echad omer: "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam" – miet. ha ketzad? mechubbarin – yaalu, pershu – afillu hen berosh hammizbeach, yerdu.
Pershu lo yaalu [vechulei]. amar rabbi zera: lo shanu ella sheppershu kelappe matta, aval kelappe mala – karove hu deakrivu leikkul. vaafillu pershu?!
Amar rabba, hachi kaamar: lo shanu ella sheppershu leachar zerika, aval pershu kodem zerika – atay zerika usheritinhu, afillu lemebad minnayyhu (kata) [kattata] desakkine.
Savar la ki ha deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael: neemar "lo yihye" beola, veneemar "lo yihye" beasham; ma asham – atzmotav muttarin, af ola – (atzamot) [atzmoteha] muttarin.
Mufene; dei la mufene – ikka lemifrach: ma leasham, shekken besaro muttar! "lo yihye" yattira ketiv.
Metiv rav adda bar ahava: atzmot kadashim, lifne zerika – moalin bahen,
Leachar zerika – en moalin bahen. veshel ola – moalin bahen leolam!
Ema: veshel ola, pershu lifne zerika – en moalin bahen, leachar zerika – moalin bahen leolam.
Ufeliga derabbi elazar; deamar rabbi elazar: pershu lifne zerika – moalin bahem, leachar zerika – lo nehenin velo moalin.

Mishna vechullan sheppaku meal gabbe hammizbeach – lo yachzir, vechen gachelet sheppaka meal gabbe hammizbeach – lo yachazir. evarim sheppaku meal gabbe hammizbeach kodem chatzot – yachzir, umoalin bahen; leachar chatzot – lo yachzir, veen moalin bahem.
Keshem shehammizbeach mekaddesh et harauy lo, kach hakkevesh mekaddesh. keshem shehammizbeach vehakkevesh mekaddeshin et harauy lahen, kach hakkelim mekaddeshin.
Gemara hechi dame? i deit behu mammash – afillu leachar chatzot name! i delet behu mammash – afillu kodem chatzot name la! la tzericha,
b: Bishrire. mena hane mille?
Amar rav, katuv echad omer: "kol hallayla" vehiktir, vechatuv echad omer: "kol hallayla... veherim".
Challekehu, chetzyo lehaketara vechetzyo laharama.

Metiv rav kahana: bechol yom torem et hammizbeach mikkerot haggever, o samuch lo millefanav [o] meacharav. beyom hakkippurim – bachatzot. bargalim – baashmoret harishona. vei salka datach mechatzot deorayyta, hechi makdeminan vehechi meacharinan?
Ella amar rabbi yochanan: mimmashma shenneemar "kol hallayla" – eni yodea shead habboker? ma talmud lomar "ad boker"? ten boker levokro shel layla.

Hilkach, kol yoma – mikkerot haggever saggi. beyom hakkippurim, mishshum chulesha dechohen gadol – mechatzot. birgalim, dinfishi korbanot dekadmi atu yisrael – meashmoret harishona; kidkatane sefa: lo hayta keriyyayt haggever maggaat ad shehayta azara melea miyyisrael.
Ittemar: pershu kodem chatzot vehechziran achar chatzot – rabba amar:

a: Chatzot sheni ochaltan, rav chisda amar: ammud hashshachar ochaltan.
Amri be rav: may tama derav chisda? uma chatzot sheen ose lina, ose ikkul; ammud hashshachar sheose lina, eno din sheose ikkul?
Pershu kodem chatzot, vehechziran leachar ammud hashshachar – rabba amar: chatzot sheni ochaltan, rav chisda amar: en bahen ikkul leolam.
Matkef la rav yosef: uman lema lan dachatzot berosh hammizbeach meshavveya lehu ikkul? dilma kol hecha demashkecha lehu meshavveya lehu ikkul! shelachu mittam: hilcheta kerav yosef.

Ittemar name, amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: pershu kodem chatzot vehechziran achar chatzot – lo nehenin velo moalin. vechen tana bar kappara: pershu kodem chatzot vehechziran leachar chatzot – yotzin mide meila.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: vechi meachar dishlachu mittam hilcheta kerav yosef, veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba vechen tane bar kappara – rabba verav chisda bemay peligi? amar leh: bishmenim.
Bea minneh rava merabba: lina moelet berosho shel mizbeach, o enah moelet berosho shel mizbeach? hechi dame? illema delo yardu – hasheta lanu baazara amrat delo yerdu, berosho shel mizbeach mibbaya?!
Veella deyardu leshulchan medammenan la; ditnan: afillu hen al hashshulchan yamim rabbim – en bechach kelum, o dilma lekarka medammenan?
Amar leh: en lina berosho shel mizbeach. kibbela minneh, o la? ta shema, deittemar: evarim shellanu baazara – mekatter veholech kol hallayla. lan berosho shel mizbeach – mekatter veholech leolam.
Yardu – rabba amar: yaalu, rava amar: lo yaalu. shema minna: la kaybla minneh! shema minna.

Keshem shehammizbeach mekaddesh kulei. tanu rabbanan: "hannogea bemizbeach" – en li ella mizbeach; kevesh minnayin? talmud lomar: "et hammizbeach". kele sharet minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol hannogea bahem yikdash".
Bea minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan: kele sharet mahu sheyyekaddeshu et happesulin? amar leh, tenetuha: keshem shehammizbeach vehakkevesh mekaddeshin et harauy lahen, kach kelim mekaddeshin!
Amar leh: lechattechilla likrav kamibbee li. ha name tenena:
b: Shekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damo; may, lav shekkibbelu pesulin vezarku pesulin?
Lo, shekkibbelu pesulin. i name shezzarku pesulin.
Avir mizbeach – kemizbeach dame, o la? ta shema: keshem shehammizbeach mekaddesh, kach kevesh mekaddesh.
Vei amrat avir mizbeach lav kammizbeach dame – avir kevesh name lav kechevesh dame; hechi massek leh mikkevesh lemizbeach? have leh yarud!
Denaged leh. veha avir yesh ben kevesh lammizbeach! rubbo lakkevesh – kakkevesh, rubbo lammizbeach – kammizbeach.
Tifshot meha – ha devae rame bar chama yesh chibbur leolin o la, tifshot deyesh chibbur! ha la kashya, tifshot.
Matkef la rava bar rav chanan: vei amrat avir mizbeach kammizbeach dame, olat haof defasla bemachshava hechi mashkachat la?
Ha kalta mizbeach!
Matkef la rav shimi bar ashe: allema la mashkachat la? kegon deamar: hareni molkah al menat lehoridah lemachar ulehaalotah ulehaktirah.
Hanicha lerava, deamar: lina moelet berosh hammizbeach; ella lerabba, deamar: en lina moelet berosh hammizbeach – leta lemachshavto!
Lerabba name mashkachat la – kegon deamar: hareni molkah al menat lehoridah kodem ammud hashshachar, ulehaalotah leachar ammud hashshachar.
Lehach gisa miha tifshot – daavir mizbeach kemizbeach dame; dei salka datach avir mizbeach lav kemizbeach dame,

a: Chattat haof pesula hechi mazze middamah? have leh yarud! shear pesulim hechi zarek lehu middamah?
Demagga lehu. ha hazzaa hi?! mitztzuy hi! ha zerika?! sheficha hi!
Veod, derech hazzaa bechach?! derech zerika bechach?!
Amar rav ashe: i denaket lehu berosh hammizbeach – hachi name; ki kaamar – ditlanhu bekanya. may? teku.

Mishna kele hallach mekaddeshin et hallach, umiddot yavesh mekaddeshot et hayyavesh. en keli hallach mekaddeshet et hayyavesh, velo yavesh mekaddesh et hallach. kele hakkodesh shennikkevu, im osin bahen meen melachtan shehayu osin, vehen shelemim – mekaddeshin, veim lav – en mekaddeshin. vechullan en mekaddeshin ella bakkodesh.
Gemara amar shemuel: lo shanu ella middot, aval mizrakot – mekaddeshin, shenneemar: "shenehem meleim solet".
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: mincha lacha hi! amar leh: lo nitzrecha ella layyavesh shebbah. ibbaet ema: mincha legabbe dam – keyavesh dame.
Amar shemuel: kele sharet – en mekaddeshin ella shelemin, en mekaddeshin ella melein, en mekaddeshin ella mittochan. veamri lah: en mekaddeshin ella shelemin umeleim umibbifnim.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu berutze middot. bematnita tana: en mekaddeshin ella shelemin, umeleim, umittochan, uvifnim.
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella sheen dato lehosif, aval dato lehosif – rishon rishon kodesh.
Tanya name hachi: melein – en melein ella shelemin. amar rabbi yose: ematay – bizman sheen dato lehosif; aval dato lehosif – rishon rishon kodesh.
En keli hallach mekaddesh [vechulei]. amar rav, veittema rav assi: en mekaddeshin likrav, aval mekaddeshin lippasel.

Ikka dematne la aha: en meviin menachot unesachim uminchat behema uvikkurim min hamedumma, veen tzarich lomar meorla vechile hakkerem. veim hevi – lo kiddesh. amar rav, veittema rav assi: lo kiddesh likrav, aval kadash lippasel.

Tanu rabbanan: kele kodesh shennikkevu – en mattichin otan, veen mattichin letochan avar. nifgemu – en metakkenin otan. sakkin shennifgema – en mashchizin et pegimatah. nishmeta – en machzirin otah. abba shaul omer: sakkin matrefet hayta bammikdash, venimnu aleha kohanim ugenazuha.
Tanu rabbanan: bigde chehunna, en osin otam maase machat ella maase oreg, shenneemar: "maase oreg". nitgaalu, en mechabbesin [otan] lo beneter velo beahal.
Ha bammayim – mechabbesin?! amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: huggeu bemayim – mechabbesin otan beneter veahal;
b: Huggeu leneter veahal – af bemayim en mechabbesim. veyesh omrim: en mechabbesin otan kol ikkar, sheen aniyyut bimkom ashirut.

Tanu rabbanan: meil – kullo shel techelet haya, shenneemar: "vayyaas et meil haefod kelil techelet". shulav ketzad? mevi techelet veargaman vetolaat shani shezurin, veose otan kemin rimmonim shello pittechu pihen, uchemin konaot shel kenasot shebberashe tinokot.

Umevi shivim ushenayim zaggin shebbahen shivim ushenayim inbalin, vetole bahen sheloshim veshishsha betzad ze usheloshim veshishsha mitztzad ze. rabbi dosa omer mishshum rabbi yehuda: sheloshim veshishsha hayu – shemone esre mitztzad ze ushemone esre mitztzad ze.
Amar rabbi inyoni bar sason: kemachloket kan kach machloket bemarot negaim, ditnan: marot negaim – rabbi dosa ben harekinas omer: sheloshim veshishsha, akavya ben mahalalel omer: shivim ushenayim.
Veamar rabbi inyoni bar sason: lamma nismecha parashat korbanot lefarashat bigde chehunna? lomar lach: ma korbanot mechapperin, af bigde chehunna mechapperin.

Ketonet – mechapperet al shefichut (dam) [damim], shenneemar: "vayyishchatu seir izzim vayyitbelu et hakkuttonet baddam". michnasayim – mechapperet al gilluy arayot, shenneemar: "vaase lahem michnese vad [lechassot (et) besar erva]". mitznefet – mechapperet al gasse haruach. minnayin? amar rabbi chanina: yavo davar shebbaggova, vichapper al gova.
Avnet – mechapper al hirhur hallev, hecha deiteh. choshen – mechapper al haddinin, shenneemar: "veasita choshen mishpat". efod – mechapper al avoda zara, shenneemar: "en efod uterafim".

Meil – mechapper al lashon hara. minnayin? amar rabbi chanina: yavo davar shebbakkol, vichapper al kol hara. vetzitz – mechapper al azzut panim; betzitz ketiv: "vehaya al metzach aharon", uveazzut panim ketiv: "umetzach ishsha zona haya lach".
Ini?! veha amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shene devarim lo matzinu lahen kappara bekorbanot, umatzinu lahen kappara mimmakom acher; veellu hen: shefichut damim velashon hara!
Shefichut damim – meegla arufa, velashon hara – mikketoret. detane rav chananya: minnayin liktoret shemmechapperet? shenneemar: "vayyitten et hakketoret vaychapper al haam".
Vetane deve rabbi yishmael: al ma ketoret mechapperet? al lashon hara. yavo davar shebbachashay, vichapper al maase chashay.
Kashya lashon hara allashon hara, kashya shefichut damim ashshefichut damim!
La kashya; ha didia man katleh, ha dela yedia man katleh. i didia man katleh – bar ketala hu! bemezid vela atro beh.
Velashon hara allashon hara name la kashya – ha betzina, ha befarhesya.
Hadaran alach hammizbeach mekaddesh

a: Mishna kol hattadir mechavero – kodem et chavero. hattemidin kodmin lemusafin. musefe shabbat kodmin lemusefe rosh chodesh. musefe rosh chodesh kodmin lemusefe rosh hashshana, shenneemar: "millevad olat habboker asher leolat hattamid taasu et elle".
Gemara mena lan? mena lan?! kidkaamar tama: "millevad olat habboker"! dilma temidin hen dekadmi lemusafin – mishshum ditdiri; musafin lemusafin mena lan?
Amar rabbi ila, deamar kera: "kaelle taasu layyom shivat yamim" – elle kaelle.
Vehay mibbee leh legufeh! im ken, nichtov: "elle taasu layyom".
I ketav "elle taasu layyom shivat hayyamim", hava amena: elle leshivat hayyamim (in, midde acharina la)! "layyom" ketiv.
Veakkatti ema: elle layyom, aval shear yome la yadana kamma! amar kera "taasu" – sheyyehu kol haasiyyot shavot.
Abbaye amar miggufa dikra: im ken, lema kera "millevad olat habboker" vetishtok, "asher leolat hattamid" lema li? lememar dehach ditdira tikdom.
Mishna kol hamekuddash mechavero – kodem et chavero. dam hachattat kodem ledam haola, mippene shehu meratztze. evre ola kodmin leemure chattat, mippene shehu kalil laishshim.

Chattat kodemet leasham, mippene sheddamah nittan learba keranot al hayesod. asham kodem letoda veel nazir, mippene shehu kodshe kadashim. toda veel nazir kodmim lishlamim, mippene shehen neechalin leyom echad, uteunin lechem.
Hashshelamim kodmin labbechor, mippene shehen teunin mattan arba [usemicha] unesachim, utenufot chaze vashok. habbechor kodem lammaaser, mippene shekkedushshato merechem, veneechol lakkohanim.

Hammaaser kodem laofot, mippene shehu zevach, veyesh bo kodesh kodashim – damu veemurav. haofot kodmin lammenachot, mippene shehen mine damim. minchat chote kodemet leminchat nedava, mippene shehu ba al chet. chattat haof kodemet leolat haof, vechen behekdeshah.
b: Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ufar sheni ven bakar tikkach lechattat" –

Im ba lelammed shehen shenayim, hare kevar neemar: "vaase et haechad chattat veet haechad ola"; ma talmud lomar: "ufar sheni ven bakar tikkach lechattat"? sheyyachol sheyyehe chattat kodemet lechol maase ola, talmud lomar: "ufar sheni ven bakar tikkach lechattat".

I "par sheni", yachol tehe ola kodemet lechattat lechol maaseha? talmud lomar: "vaase et haechad chattat veet haechad ola". ha ketzad? dam chattat kodemet ledam ola – mippene shemmeratztza; evre ola kulei.
Veammay? mattana kammayyta dimchappera – tikdom, vehanach la!
Amar ravina: hacha bechattat haleviyyim askinan; veaf al gav dechi ola dame, kaamar rachamana hi tikdom. bemareva amri: hoil vehitchil bemattanot, gomer.
Ibbaya lehu: dam chattat veevre ola, eze mehen kodem? dam chattat kodem – mippene shemmeratztze, o dilma evre ola kodmin – mippene shehen kalil laishshim?
Ta shema: dam chattat kodem ledam ola. ledam ola hu dekadem, leevre ola la kadem.
Adderabba, missefa: evre ola kodmin leemure chattat. leemure chattat hu dekadem, ledam chattat la kadem! ella meha lekka lemishma minna.
Ibbaya lehu: dam ola veemure chattat, eze mehen kodem? dam ola kodem – dekaate mikkoach kalil, o dilma emure chattat kodmin – (dekaate) [dekaatu] mikkoach mechapper?
Ta shema: dam chattat kodem ledam ola. dam chattat hu dekadem ledam ola, aval emure chattat la.
Adderabba, missefa: evre ola kodmin leemure chattat. evre ola hu dekadmi leemure chattat, aval dam ola la! ella meha lekka lemishma minna.
Ibbaya lehu: dam ola vedam asham, eze mehen kodem? dam ola kodem – dekaate mikkoach kalil; o dilma dam asham kodem – (dekaate mikkoach) dimchapper?
Ta shema: dam chattat kodem ledam ola. aval dam asham – la.
Bedin hu deibbei lemitne dam asham; veayyeyde diva lemitne sefa: evre ola kodmin leemure chattat –
Dei tena leemure asham, hava amena: leemure asham hu dekadmi, leemure chattat la kadmi – mishshum hachi tena chattat.
Ta shema: chattat kodem leasham – chattat hu dekadma leh leasham, aval ola la. may, lav dam?
La; aemurim. dayka name, dekatane "mippene sheddamah nittan". shema minna.
Chattat kodemet kulei. adderabba – asham kadem, shekken yesh lo kitztzeva! afillu hachi, ribbuy demizbeach adif.
Asham kodem letoda kulei. adderabba – hattoda veel nazir kadmi, shekken teunin lechem! afillu hachi, kodshe kadashim adifi.
Toda veel nazir kulei. adderabba – shelamim kadmi, shekken yeshnan betzibbur kivyachid! afillu hachi, neechalin leyom echad adifi.

Ibbaya lehu: toda veel nazir – eze mehen kodem? toda kadma, shekken teuna arbaa mine lechem; o dilma el nazir kodem, shekken yesh immo damim acherim? ta shema: zo kodemet lazo, shezzo teuna arbaa mine lechem, vezo enah teuna ella shene mine lechem.
Vehashshelamim kodmin livchor kulei. adderabba – bechor kodem, shekken kedushshato merechem, veneechol lakkohanim! afillu hachi, mitzvot yeterot adifi.
Habbechor kodem kulei. adderabba – maaser kodem, shekken mekaddesh lefanav uleacharav! afillu hachi, kedushsha merechem adifa.
Maaser kodem laofot kulei. adderabba – ofot kadmi, shekken kodshe kadashim! afillu hachi, min zevach adif.
Amar ravina bar shela: emure kadashim kallim sheyyatzu lifne zerikat damim – pesulin. utena tuna: mippene shehu zevach, veyeshno kodshe kadashim – damav veemurin.
Bishlama emurin – letanhu beofot; ella dam miha iteh! ella lav ka mashma lan: emurin ki damo –
Ma damo lifne zerika, af emurin kodem zerika – veka kare lehu kodshe kadashim; uma damo mippesel beyotze, af emurin mippesel beyotze.
Nema mesayyay leh: besar kadashim kallim sheyyatza lifne zerikat damim – rabbi yochanan amar: kasher, resh lakish amar: pesul.
Rabbi yochanan amar kasher – hoil vesofo latzet, resh lakish amar pasul – adayin lo higgia zemanno latzet. ad kan la peligi – ella bevasar, aval beemurin la!
Hu haddin divemurin name peligi; veha deka mippalgi bevasar – lehodiacha kocho deresh lakish, daafillu basar desofah latzet, amar: adayin lo higgia zemanno latzet.
Lema ketannae: emure kadashim kallim sheyyatzu lifne zerikat damim – rabbi eliezer omer: en moalin bahen,

a: Veen chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul notar vetame; rabbi akiva omer: moalin bahen, vechayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul notar vetame.
May, lav bedahadar ayyeylinhu peligi? uveha peligi: demar savar mippasli beyotze, umar savar la mippasli beyotze.
Amar rav pappa: bedahadar ayyeylinhu – kulle alma la peligi; vehacha biditanhu abbaray peligi, uveha peligi: demar savar en zerika moelet layyotze, umar savar zerika moelet layyotze.
Veha rav pappa hu deamar: biditanhu abbaray – kulle alma la peligi, bidayyeylinhu legavvavy peligi!
Hane mille gabbe shete lechem – delav gufeh dezivcha; aval emurin, degufeh dezivcha hu – biditanhu abbaray peligi.
Ofot kodmin kulei. adderabba – menachot kodmot, shekken yeshnan betzibbur kevayyachid! afillu hachi, mine damim adifi.
Minchat chote kulei. adderabba – minchat nedava kodemet, shekken teuna shemen ulevona! afillu hachi, minchat chote habbaa al chet adifa, dimchapperet.
Ibbaya lehu: minchat sota uminchat nedava, ezo mehen kodemet? minchat nedava kadma – shekken teuna shemen (o) ulevona, o dilma minchat sota kadma – shekken baa levarer avon?

Ta shema: minchat chote kodemet leminchat nedava. minchat chote hu dekadma leminchat nedava, ha minchat sota – la! mi katane "mippene shehi mechapperet"?! "mippene shehi baa al chet" katane, veha name baa al chet.
Ta shema: zo kodemet lazo, shezzo baa min hachittin vezo baa min hasseorin. may, lav minchat nedava leminchat sota? la, minchat chote leminchat sota.
Tippok li deha mechappera veha la mechappera!
Veella may, minchat nedava? tippok li dezo teuna shemen ulevona, vezo enah teuna shemen ulevona! ella chad mittere tame [naket].

Chattat haof kodemet kulei. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "vehikriv et asher lachattat rishona" – ma talmud lomar? sheen talmud lomar lelammed shettikrav rishona, hare kevar neemar: "veet hashsheni yaase ola".
Ella ze bana av lechol chattaot sheyyikdemu (leola) [leolot] habbaot immahen – ben chattat haof leolat haof, ben chattat behema leolat behema, vaafillu chattat haof leolat behema.
Hilkach, chattat haof leolat haof – mivveet hashsheni", chattat behema leolat behema – midderabbi rachamana, chattat haof leolat behema – mizze bana av.
Ta shema, rabbi eliezer omer: kol makom shennitchallefa chattat – chattat kodemet, vechan (beyoledet) – ola kodemet.
Kol makom shebba al chet – chattat kodemet, vechan ola kodemet; vechol makom sheshshenayim baim tachat chattat – chattat kodemet, vechan ola kodemet.
Amar rava: lemikraah hikdimah hakkatuv.
Ta shema: parim kodmin leelim, veelim kodmin lichvashim, kevasim lisirim.
b: May, lav dechag? la, lindava. parim kodmin leelim – shekken nitrabbu binsachim. vechen elim lichvasim. kevasim lisirim – shekken nitrabbu bealya.
Ta shema: par kohen mashiach kodem lefar helem davar shel tzibbur, par helem davar shel tzibbur kodem lefar avoda zara,
Par avoda zara kodem lisire avoda zara. deaf al gav defar avoda zara ola, useire avoda zara chattat!
Veema meresha: par helem davar shel tzibbur kodem lefar avoda zara!
Bechad mina miha la kaamrinan, dechattat kadma. ki kaamrinan bitre mine – ashkechan ola dekadma lechattat!
Amri bemareva mishshemeh derava bar mari: chattat avoda zara chaser 1 – "lechattat" ketiv. ravina amar: "kammishpat" ketiv behu.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, afillu tema parim dechag name – "kemishpatam" ketiv behu.

Ibbaya lehu: chattat haof veolat behema umaaser, ezo mehen kodem? tikdom chattat haof – ikka maaser dekadem la. likdom maaser – ikka olat behema dekadma leh. tikdom olat behema – ikka chattat haof dekadma la.
Hacha targimu: min zevach adif. bemareva amri: ayyla ba olat behema bechattat haof, veagbahta mimmaaser.
Mishna kol hachattaot shebbattora kodmot laashamot, chutz measham metzora – mippene shehu ba al hechsher.
Kol haashamot shebbattora bain bene shetayim uvain bechesef shekalim, chutz measham nazir vaasham metzora – shehen bain bene shennatan, veen bain bechesef shekalim.

Keshem shekkodmin behakeravatan, kodmin baachilatan. shelamim shel emesh ushelamim shel yom – shel emesh kodmin leshel yom. shelamim shel emesh, chattat veasham shel hayyom – shelamim shel emesh kodmin. divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: chattat kodemet, mippene shehi kodshe kadashim.

Vechullan hakkohanim rashshain leshannot baachilatan – leachlan tzeluyin ushelukin umevushshalin, latet letocho tavle chullin vetavle teruma. divre rabbi shimon. rabbi meir omer: lo yitten letocho tavle teruma, shello yavi hatteruma lide fesul.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: tadir umekuddash, eze mehem kodem? tadir kodem – mishshum ditdir, o dilma mekuddash kadem – dekaddish? ta shema: temidin kodmin lemusafin.

a: Veaf al gav demusafin kaddishi! attu shabbat lemusafin ahanay, litmidin la ahanay?!
Ta shema: musefe shabbat kodmin lemusefe rosh chodesh! attu rosh chodesh lemusafin dideh ahani, lemusefe shabbat la ahani?!
Ta shema: musefe rosh chodesh kodmin lemusefe rosh hashshana. af al gav derosh hashshana kaddisha! attu rosh hashshana lemusefe dideh ahani, lemusefe rosh chodesh la ahani?!

Ta shema: davar acher – birkat hayyayin tedira uvirkat hayyom enah tedira, vetadir vesheeno tadir – tadir kodem. af al gav devirkat hayyom kaddisha! attu shabbat levirkat hayyom ahanay, levirkat hayyayin la ahanay?!
Ta shema, deamar rabbi yochanan: halacha – mitpallel adam shel mincha, veachar kach shel musafin! attu shabbat litfillat musafin ahanay, litfillat mincha la ahanay?!
Ta shema: shelamim shel emesh, chattat veasham shel yom – shelamim shel emesh kodmin. ha idde veidde deyom – chattat veasham kadmi, veaf al gav dishlamim tediri!
Amar rava: matzuy kaamrat?! tadir kamibbaya lan, matzuy la kamibbaya lan.
Amar leh rav huna bar yehuda lerava: attu matzuy lav tadir?! vehatanya: otzi et happesach sheeno tadir, velo otzi et hammila shehi tedira!
May tedira – tedira bemitzvot. veibbaet ema: mila legabbe pesach – ki tadir damya.

Ibbaya lehu: tadir vesheeno tadir, ukedem ushechat lesheeno tadir, may? mi amrinan: kevan deshachteh – makrev leh; o dilma, yahev leacher dimmares bedamo ad demakrev leh letadir, vahadar makrev lesheeno tadir?
Amar rav huna missura, ta shema: shelamim shel emesh, chattat veasham shel yom – shel emesh kodem leshel yom. ha deyom dumeya deemesh –
Vehechi dame, dikdem shachteh lishlamim – chattat veasham kadmi!
Dilma shelamim deemesh vechattat veasham deyom hechi mashkachat la – deshachtinhu letarvayyhu; aval la shachtinhu letarvayyhu – tibbee lach.
Ta shema: davar acher – birkat hayyayin tedira uvirkat hayyom enah tedira, vetadir vesheeno tadir – tadir kodem!
Hacha name, dechevan (deatyayn) [daata yayin] – keman dishchiti tarvayyhu dame.
Ta shema, deamar rabbi yochanan: halacha, mitpallel adam shel mincha veachar kach shel musafin! hacha name, kevan demate zeman tefillat mincha – keman dishchiti tarvayyhu dame.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav ashe leravina: shechato kodem chatzot – pasul, mippene shenneemar bo "ben haarbayim". kodem lattamid – kasher, vihe memares bedamo ad sheyyizrok haddam!

Hacha bemay askinan, kegon dikdem shachteh letamid beresha. amar leh rav acha sava lerav ashe: matnitin name dayka – dekatane "ad sheyyizzarek haddam" (tamid), vela katane "ad sheyyishchot veyizrok dam". shema minna.
Uvechullan kohanim rashshain kulei. may tama? amar kera "lemoshcha" – ligdulla, kederech shehammelachim ochlin.
Mishna amar rabbi shimon: im raita shemen shehu mitchallek baazara – en tzarich lishol mahu; ella motar rekike menachot yisrael, velog shemen shel metzora.
Im raita shemen shehu nittan al gabbe haishshim – en tzarich lishol mahu; ella motar rekike minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach, sheen mitnaddevin shemen. rabbi tarfon omer: mitnaddevin shemen.
b: Gemara amar shemuel: ledivre rabbi tarfon, hammitnaddev shemen – komtzo usheyarav neechalin. may tama? amar kera: "korban mincha" – melammed shemmitnaddevin shemen; vechi mincha – ma mincha komtzah usheyareha neechalin, af shemen komtzo usheyarav neechalin.

Amar rabbi zera: af anan name tenena, amar rabbi shimon: im raita shemen shemmitchallek baazara – i atta tzarich lishol mahu; ella motar rekike minchot yisrael velog shemen shel metzora, sheen mitnaddevin. mikkelal deman deamar mitnaddevin – mitchallek.

Amar leh abbaye, ema sefa: im raita shemen shennittan al gabbe ishshim – i atta tzarich lishol mahu; ella motar rekike minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach, sheen mitnaddevin shemen. mikkelal dilman deamar mitnaddev – kullan laishshim. leabbaye kashya resha, lerabbi zera kashya sefa!
Bishlama lerabbi zera – resha beshirayim, sefa bekometz. ella leabbaye – kashya! tena resha attu sefa.
Bishlama sefa – tane mishshum resha; ella resha mishshum sefa mi tane?! in; amri bemareva: tena resha mishshum sefa.
Ta shema: yayin kedivre rabbi akiva – lassefalim, shemen kedivre rabbi tarfon – laishshim. may, lav middeyayin kullo lassefalim, shemen kullo laishshim? midde irya? ha kidita veha kidita.
Amar rav pappa, ketannae: shemen lo yifchot millog. rabbi omer: sheloshet luggin. bemay kamippalgi? amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa: dun minna uminna dun minna veoke beatra ikka benayyhu.
Derabbanan savri: ma mincha mitnaddevin, af shemen mitnaddevin [uminna – ma mincha log shemen, af kan log shemen. uma mincha komtzah usheyareha neechalin, af shemen komtzo usheyarav neechalin].

Veiddach – mimmincha: ma mincha mitnaddevin, af shemen mitnaddevin; veoke beatra – kinsachim: ma nesachim sheloshet luggin [af shemen (shalosh) [shelosha] luggin, uma nesachim kullan lassefalin] – af shemen (kullan) [kullo] laishshim.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: i mimmincha mayyte la [rabbi], dechulle alma dun minna uminna! ella rabbi meezrach" gamar la.

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa: mi matzet amrat hachi?! vehatanya: "korban mincha" – melammed shemmitnaddevin shemen. vechamma? shelosha luggin. uman shamat leh deamar shelosha luggin – rabbi hi; veka mayyte la mikkorban"! amar leh: i tanya tanya.

Amar shemuel: hammitnaddev yayin, mevi umezallefo al gabbe haishshim. may tama? amar kera: "veyayin takriv lannesech chatzi hahin ishshe reach nichoach laAdonai". veha ka mechabbe! kibbuy bemiktzat la shemeh kibbuy.
Ini?! vehaamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hammorid gachelet meal gabbe hammizbeach vechibbah – chayyayv, delekka ella hay! ibbaet ema: kibbuy demitzva shane.
Ta shema, detana rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: kelappe shennittena tora litrom, yachol yechabbe veyitrom? amrat: lo yechabbe! shane hatam, efshar deyatev venatar.
Ta shema: yayin kedivre rabbi akiva – lassefalim, shemen kedivre rabbi tarfon – laishshim! veod tanya: yayin (nesech) – [lenassech] lassefalim. o eno ella laishshim? amarta: lo yechabbe!
La kashya; ha rabbi yehuda, ha rabbi shimon. lememra dishmuel kerabbi shimon sevira leh?! vehaamar shemuel: mechabbin gachelet shel mattechet birshut harabbim, bishvil shello yizzoku bah rabbim.

a: Aval lo gachelet shel etz. vei salka datach kerabbi shimon sevira leh, afillu gachelet shel etz name!
Bedavar sheen mitkavven – savar la kerabbi shimon, bimlacha sheenah tzericha legufah – savar la kerabbi yehuda.

Amar rav huna: nesachim shennitmeu – ose lahen maaracha bifne atzman vesorfan, mishshum shenneemar: "bakkodesh baesh tissaref". tanya name hachi: haddam vehashshemen vehammenachot vehannesachim shennitmeu – ose lahen maaracha bifne atzman vesorfan.
Amar leh shemuel lerav chana bagdataa: ayyti li be asra, veema lach kammayyhu: nesachim shennitmeu, ose lahen maaracha bifne atzman vesorfan.
Hadaran alach kol hattadir

Mishna dam chattat shennittaz al habbeged – hare ze taun kibbus, af al pi sheen hakkatuv medabber ella beneechalot – shenneemar: "bemakom kadosh teachel". echad hanneechalot veechad happenimiyyot teunot kibbus, shenneemar: "torat hachattat" – tora achat lechol hachattaot.

Chattat pesula – en damah taun kibbus, ben shehayta lah sheat hakkosher uven shello hayta lah sheat hakkosher. ezo hi shehayta lah sheat hakkosher? shellana, veshennitmea, vesheyyatzat. veezo hi shello hayta lah sheat hakkosher? shennishchata chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah, veshekkibbelu pesulin (vezarku) et damah.
Gemara dam chattat (shemmeta) [shennittaz] kulei. vei tora achat lechol chattaot, afillu chattat haof name! allema tanya: yachol tehe dam chattat haof taun kibbus? talmud lomar "zot".
Amar resh lakish mishshum bar kappara, amar kera: "tishshachet" – benishchatot hakkatuv medabber.
Veema beneechalot hakkatuv medabber – kedichtiv: "bemakom kadosh teachel", aval penimiyyot la! rabbi rachamana "torat".
I hachi, afillu chattat haof name! miet rachamana "zot".
Uma raita? mistabbera dechattat [behema] penimiyyot hava leh lerabboye – shekken behema, shechitat tzafon, vekabbalat keli,
b: Vekeren, veetzba, vechuddah, veishshim.
Adderabba, chattat haof hava leh lerabboye – shekken chutz kemotah, vaachila kemotah! hanach nefishin.
Rav yosef amar, amar kera: "yochlenna" – lazo velo leacheret; beneechalot miet hakkatuv.
Veella "zot" lema li? i lav "zot", have amena: "yochlenna" – orcheh dikra; ka mashma lan.
Rabba amar, amar kera: "asher yizze" – behazzaot hakkatuv medabber.
Vehatanya: af al pi sheen hakkatuv medabber ella beneechalot! leinyan merika ushetifa, aval leinyan kibbus – "asher yizze" ketiv.
I hachi, "echad hanneechalot veechad happenimiyyot"?! "echad happenimiyyot veechad hanneechalot" mibbee leh! teni: "echad happenimiyyot veechad hanneechalot".
I hachi, chattat haof name! mayet rachamana "zot". i hachi, chitzona name la! rabbi rachamana "torat".
Uma raita? mistabbera chattat behema hava leh lerabboye – shekken behema, shechitat tzafon, vekabbalat keli, vekeren, veetzba, vechuddah, veishshim.
Adderabba, chattat haof hava leh lerabboye – shekken hazzaa kemotah! hanach nefishin.
Bae rabbi avin: chattat haof shehichnis damah betzavvarah bifnim, mahu? tzavvarah kichli sharet dame, umippesil;
O dilma ketzavvar behema – "middamah" amar rachamana, vela besarah? ta shema: pirkesa venichnesa lifnim vechazra – keshera. ha hichnisah – pesula!
Velitamaych, gabbe kodshe kadashim dekatane: pirkesa veyatza laddarom vechazra – keshera; ha hotziah – pesula?!
Ella hay yatzta lachutz itztericha leh; hacha name yatzta lachutz itztericha leh.
Bae rabbi avin: nishpach al haritzpa vaasafah, mahu?
Atzroche hu dela atzrecheh rachamana keli sharet, vehilkach osfo vechasher; o dilma mifsal pesal beh rachamana kele sharet, vehilkach osfo ufasul?
Amar rava, ta shema: yachol yehe dam chattat haof taun kibbus? talmud lomar: "zot". vei salka datach mifsal pasel beh rachamana, tippok li deha ippesil le baavir keli!
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: bemadbik keli betzavvarah.
Bea minneh levi: nittaz mibbeged leveged, mahu? mibbeged kamma iddechi leh lechibbus, o dilma la?
Amar leh: zo sheela! taun kibbus. mimma nafshach; i osfo vechasher – ha kasher. vei osfo ufasul – ana kerabbi akiva sevira li, deamar: hayta (lo) [lah] sheat hakkosher venifsela – damah taun kibbus.

a: Bea minneh rame bar chama merav chisda: nittaz al beged tame, mahu? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: middekamibbaya leh hachi, shema minna: hayta lah sheat hakkosher venifsela – en damah taun kibbus.
Hane mille beze achar ze, aval bevat achat la; o dilma la shena? amar leh: pelugeta derabbi elazar verabbanan allibba derabba, vechidka metaretz abbaye.
Detanya, rabbi elazar omer: me chattat shennitmeu – metaharin, shehare nidda mazzin aleha.
Veamar rabba: rabbi elazar beshitat rabbi akiva rabbo amarah, deamar: haavarat keli al gabbe makom tame – kemunnach dame.

Ditnan: haya omed chutz lattannur vesheretz battannur, vehoshit yado lachallon venatal et hallagin veheeviro al pi tannur – rabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin. uveha peligi – derabbi akiva savar: kemunnach dame, verabbanan savri: lav kemunnach dame.

Veetiveh abbaye: mode rabbi akiva behazzaa sheheevirah al kele cheres tame al gabbe mishkav umoshav tame – shehi tehora; sheen lecha davar shemmetamme lemala kilmatta, ella kezayit min hammet ushear kol hammaahilin. leetoye even hamenuggaat!

Ella amar abbaye: dechulle alma – lav kemunnach dame; vehacha beha kamippalgi: derabbi akiva savar gazrinan shemma yanuach, verabbanan savri la gazrinan. umode rabbi akiva behazzaa – kevan dinfak nefak.
Verabbi elazar verabbanan bemay kamippalgi? amar abbaye: bedanin tumea keduma mittumea shebbeotah shaa kamippalgi –
Mar savar danin, umar savar en danin.
Rava amar: dechulle alma en danin;
Vehacha beha kamippalgi – derabbi elazar savar: hazzaa tzericha shiur, umitztarfin lehazzaot; verabbanan savri: hazzaa en tzericha shiur.

Chattat pesula kulei. tanu rabbanan: "middamah" – middam keshera velo middam pesula. rabbi akiva omer: hayta lah sheat hakkosher venifsela – damah taun kibbus, lo hayta lah sheat hakkosher venifsela – en damah taun kibbus.
Verabbi shimon omer: echad ze veechad ze, en damah taun kibbus. may tama derabbi shimon? ketiv "otah", uchetiv "middamah" – chad lehecha dehayta lo sheat hakkosher.
Verabbi akiva – "otah" perat litruma. verabbi shimon letameh, deamar: kadashim kallim en teunin merika ushetifa – vechol shekken teruma.

Mishna nittaz min hatztzavvar al habbeged – eno taun kibbus. min hakkeren umin hayesod – eno taun kibbus. nishpach al haritzpa vaasafo – en taun kibbus. en taun kibbus ella dam shennitkabbel bichli, verauy lehazzaa.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: yachol nittaz min hatztzavvar al habbeged – yehe taun kibbus? talmud lomar: "asher yizze" – lo amarti lach ella berauy lehazzaa. tanya iddach: yachol nittaz min hakkeren umin hayesod yehe taun kibbus? talmud lomar: "asher yizze" – perat laze shekkevar huzza.
Nishpach al haritzpa kulei.
b: Ha tu lema li? ma taam kaamar: ma taam nishpach al haritzpa vaasafo en taun kibbus – lefi sheen taun kibbus ella dam shennitkabbel bichli verauy lehazzayay.
Rauy lehazzaa – lemaote may? lemaote kibbel pachot mikkede hazzayay bichli ze ufachot mikkede hazzayay bichli ze.
Detanya, rabbi chalafta bar shaul omer: kiddesh pachot mikkede hazzayay bichli ze ufachot mikkede hazzayay bichli ze – lo kiddesh.
Ibbaya lehu: bedam mahu? hilcheta hi, umehilcheta la gamrinan;
O dilma, hatam may tama – dichtiv "vetaval bammayim", hacha name ketiv "vetaval baddam".
Ta shema, deamar rabbi zerika amar rabbi elazar: af bedam – lo kiddesh.
Amar rava, tanya: "vetaval" – velo mesappeg. "baddam" – ad sheyyehe baddam shiur tevila meikkaro. "min haddam" – min haddam shebbainyan.
Veitzterich lemichtav "baddam"; dei ketav rachamana "vetaval", hava amena af al pi delekka shiur tevila meikkaro; ketav [rachamana] "baddam".
Vei ketav rachamana "baddam", hava amena afillu mesappeg; ketav rachamana "vetaval".
Min haddam shebbeinyan – lemaote may? amar rava: lemaote shirayim shebbaetzba. mesayyay lerabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: shirayim shebbaetzba – pesulin.
Amar leh ravin bar rav adda lerav: amar talmidcha, amar rav amram, tenena: haya mazze venitteza hazzaa miyyado – ad shello hizza, taun kibbus. mishshehizza, en taun kibbus.

May, lav hachi kaamar: ad shello gamar millehazzot – taun kibbus, mishsheggamar lehazzot – en taun kibbus? la; hachi kaamar: ad shello yatzta hazzaa miyyado – taun kibbus, mishsheyyatzta hazzaa miyyado – en taun kibbus.
Etiveh abbaye: gamar millehazzot – mekanneach yado begufah shel para. gamar in, lo gamar la! amar leh: gamar – mekanneach yado begufah shel para, lo gamar – mekanneach etzbao.
Bishlama gamar – mekanneach yado begufah shel para, shenneemar: "vesaraf et happara leenav". ella etzbao – bemay mekanneach? amar abbaye: bisfat mizrak, kedichtiv: "kefore zahav".
Mishna nittaz al haor ad shello hufeshat – eno taun kibbus, mishshehufeshat – taun kibbus. divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi elazar omer: af mishshehufeshat; eno taun kibbus ella mekom haddam, vedavar shehu rauy lekabbel tumea, verauy lechibbus.

Echad habbeged veechad hassak veechad haor – teunin kibbus; vehakkibbus bemakom kadosh, ushevirat keli cheres bemakom kadosh, umerika ushetifa bichli nechoshet bimkom kadosh. ze chomer bechattat mikkodshe kadashim.
Gemara menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "beged" – en li ella beged, minnayin lerabbot or mishshehufeshat? talmud lomar: "asher yizze aleha techabbes".
Yachol sheani merabbe or ad shello hufeshat? talmud lomar "beged" – ma beged harauy lekabbel tumea, af kol harauy lekabbel tumea. divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi elazar omer: "beged" – en li ella beged, minnayin lerabbot sak

a: Vechol mine vegadim? talmud lomar: "asher aleha techabbes". yachol sheani merabbe or mishshehufeshat? talmud lomar "beged" – ma beged davar hamekabbel tumea, af kol davar hamekabbel tumea.
May benayyhu? amar abbaye: matlet pechuta mishshalosh ikka benayyhu; man deamar rauy – ha name rauy, dei bae chashshev aleh. man deamar davar hamekabbel tumea – ha miha lav bat kabbole tumea hi.

Rava amar: beged shechishshev aleha letzura ikka benayyhu; man deamar rauy – ha name rauy, dei bae mevattel leh lemachshavteh. man deamar davar hamekabbel tumea – hasheta miha lav bat kabbole tumea hi.

Rava amar: utzeba dechashshev ala lekatztzeah ikka benayyhu; man deamar rauy – ha name reuya; man deamar davar hamekabbel tumea – ha lav mekabbela tumea ad dimkatztza la. vehatanya, rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: utzeba shechishshev aleha lekatztzeah – tehora ad sheyyekatztzeenna.
En taun kibbus kulei. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: yachol nittaz al miktzat beged – yehe kol habbeged taun kibbus? talmud lomar "asher yizze" – lo amarti lecha ella mekom dam bilvad.
Davar shehu rauy lekabbel tumea [vechulei]. setama kerabbi yehuda.
Rauy lechibbus. lemaote keli, devar gerida hu.
Echad habbeged veechad hassak kulei. lememra deor bar kibbus hu?! ureminhu: hayta alav lashleshet – mekannechah bismartut. hayta al shel or – noten aleha mayim ad shettichle!
Amar abbaye: la kashya; ha rabbanan ha acherim. detanya: habbeged vehassak – mechabbeso, hakkeli vehaor – megarro. acherim omrim: habbeged vehassak vehaor – mechabbeso, vehakkeli – megarro.
Keman azla ha deamar rav chiyyay bar ashe: zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav, veshachshechi leh mesaneh bemayya? keman – kerabbanan.

Amar rava: umi ikka leman deamar, or lav bar kibbus hu?! vehachtiv: "vehabbeged o hashsheti o haerev o chol keli haor asher techabbes"! ella amar rava: kera umatnitin – berakkin, ki peligi – bekashin.
Vehaamar rav chiyyay: zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav, veshachshechi leh mesaneh bemayya! bekashin, ucherabbanan.
Hadar amar rava: lav milleta hi daamari; neku nema leh likra dechi chetivan berakkin ketivan?! mi la askinan bichle ekkesalgeya habbaim mimmedinat hayyam, vekaamar rachamana nive kibbus?
Ella amar rava: tzaraat – kevan demiggufeh ka farcha, mechalchala leh umeshavveya la rach. amar rava: i kashya li, ha kashya li:
b: Karim uchesatot – derakkin ninhu, utenan: hayta shel or noten aleha mayim ad shettichle! ella amar rava: kol kibbus delet leh kiskus, la shemeh kibbus.
Veha deamar rav chiyyay bar ashe: zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav, veshachshechi leh mesaneh bemayya; shichshuch in, aval kibbus la – i berakkin uchedivre hakkol, i bekashin vechaacherim.
I hachi, beged name! beged – sheriyyayto zehu kibbuso.
Rava letameh – deamar rava: zarak sudar lemayim – chayyayv. zarak pishtan lemayim – chayyayv. bishlama sudar – aved kibbus; ella zera pishtan may tama?
Vechi tema mishshum demikaddach – i hachi, chitte useare name! hanach it lehu rire. i hachi, shelachim name! hatam kaaved lisha.

Daresh rava: muttar lechabbes minal beshabbat. amar leh rav pappa lerava, veha amar rav chiyyay bar ashe: zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav, veshachshechi leh mesane bemayya; shichshuch in, aval kibbus la! hadar oke rava amora aleh uderash: devarim sheamarti lifnechem – taut hem beyadi; beram kach amru: shichshuch muttar, kibbus asur.

Hakkibbus bemakom kadosh kulei. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "techabbes bemakom kadosh". shevirat keli cheres minnayin? talmud lomar: "ucheli cheres asher tevushshal bo yishshaver". merika ushetifa bichli nechoshet minnayin? talmud lomar: "veim bichli nechoshet bushshala, umorak veshuttaf bammayim".
Ze chomer bechattat kulei. vetu lekka?! vehaikka shennichnas damah lifnay velifnim! bechattaot hachitzonot.
Sheim nichnas damah (lifnay v)lifnim – pesula! kerabbi akiva, deamar: kol damim shennichnesu lahechol lechapper – pesula.
Shekken mechapperin al chayyayve charetot! bechattat dishmiat hakkol.
Shekken teuna arba mattanot! kerabbi yishmael, deamar: kol damim teunin arba mattanot al arba keranot.
Velitamaych, haikka keren! haikka etzba! haikka chuddah! ella chad mittere telata chumere naket.

Mishna beged sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim – nichnas umechabbeso bemakom kadosh. nitma chutz lakkelaim – koro, nichnas umechabbeso bimkom kadosh. keli cheres sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim – nichnas veshovro bemakom kadosh. nitma chutz lakkelaim – nokvo, venichnas veshovro bemakom kadosh.
Keli nechoshet sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim – nichnas umorko veshotfo bemakom kadosh. nitma chutz lakkelaim – pochato, venichnas umorko veshotfo bemakom kadosh.
Gemara matkef la ravina: koro?! "beged" amar rachamana, velav beged hu!
Dimshayyayr beh kede maporet. ini?! vehaamar rav huna: lo shanu ella shello shiyyer bah kede maporet, aval shiyyer bah kede maporet – chibbur have!

a: Midderabbanan hu.
Keli cheres sheyyatza kulei. "keli" amar rachamana, velo keli hu! shennikkav beshoresh katan.
Keli nechoshet [kulei]. pochato [vechulei]. veha lav keli hu! deratzef [leh] mirtzayf (hu).
Amar resh lakish: meil shennitma – machniso befachot mishshalosh al shalosh umechabbeso, mishshum shenneemar: "lo yikkarea".
Motev rav adda bar ahava: heavin veharakkim, en bahen mishshum shalosh al shalosh!
Aggav avihen chashivi.
Veha bae shivat sammanin, deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: dam chattat umarot negaim, tzerichin shivat sammanin; vetanya: ella sheen machnisin me raglayim lammikdash!
b: Vechi tema demavla lehu bahade shiva sammanin, umeabbar lehu lechullehu kechad; vehatnan: heeviran shello kesidran o sheheevir shivatan keechad – lo asa velo chelum!

Vechi tema demayvla lehu bahade chad missammanin – veha tzarich lechaskes shalosh peamim bechol echad veechad tenan! ella demavla lehu berok tafel. deamar resh lakish: rok tafel tzarich sheyyehe im kol echad veechad.

Mishna echad shebbishshel bo veechad sheera letocho roteach, echad kodshe (hakkodashim) [kodashim] veechad kadashim kallim – teunin merika ushetifa. rabbi shimon omer: kadashim kallim en teunin merika ushetifa.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "asher tevushshal bo" – en li ella shebbishshel bo; era letocho roteach minnayin? talmud lomar: "vaasher tevushshal bo yishshaver".
Bae rame bar chama: telao baavir tannur, mahu? abbishshul uvillua hu dekafed rachamana, o dilma abbishshul belo billua?
Amar rava, ta shema: echad shebbishshel bo veechad sheera letocho roteach.
Billua belo bishshul – la kamibbaya lan. ki kamibbaya lan – bishshul belo billua, may?

Ta shema, deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: tannur shel mikdash – shel mattechet haya. vei salka datach bishshul belo billua la kafed, nebed shel cheres! kevan deikka sheyare menachot daafiyyaytan battannur, veikka bishshul uvillua, avdinan shel mattechet.
Hahu tannura ditcho be tichyay, asra rabba bar ahilayy lemechla lerifta leolam vaafillu bemilcha, dilma ate lemechla bechuttacha.
Metivi: en lashin et haissa bechalav, veim lash – kol happat kullah asura, mippene hergel avera.
Keyotze bo – en tashin et hattannur bealya, veim tash – kol happat kullah asura, ad sheyyassik et hattannur. teyuveta derabba bar ahilayy! teyuveta.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: vechi meachar deittotav rabba bar ahilayy, ammay amar rav: kederot befesach yishshavru? amar leh: rav moke la hahi beshel mattechet.
Vei baet ema: betannur shel cheres; ze hesseko mibbifnim, veze hesseko mibbachutz.
Venabed hesseka mibbifnim! chayes alayyhu, demittavri. hilkach, hay kuveya – hesseko mibbachutz hu, vaasir.

a: Ella kederot shel mikdash, ammay amar rachamana yishshavru? nahderinhu lechivshonot! amar rabbi zera: lefi sheen osin kivshonot birushalayim.
Amar abbaye: vechi osin ashpattot baazara?! ishtemitteh ha detane shemaya bekalnevo: shivre kele cheres nivlain bimkoman.
Ella ha deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: tannur shel mikdash shel mattechet hava – nebed decheres, dehesseko mibbefanim hu!
Dechevan deikka shete hallechem velechem happanim – daafiyyaytan betannur ukedushshatan betannur; have leh keli sharet, ucheli sharet decheres la avdinan.
b: Vaafillu rabbi yose berabbi yehuda la kaamar ella deetz, aval decheres la.

Rav yitzchak bar yehuda hava regil kammeh derame bar chama, shavkeh vaazal lerav sheshet. yoma chad pega beh, amar leh: alkafta naktan, recha ate la leyad?! mishshum deazlat lach lekammeh derav sheshet, havet lach ki rav sheshet?!

Amar leh: lav mishshum hachi; mar – ki baena milleta, pashet li missevara; ki mashkachna matnita – parcha la. rav sheshet – ki baena milleta minneh, pashet li mimmatnita; dechi name mashkachat matnita ufarcha – matnita umatnita hi.
Amar leh: bei minnay milleta, deifshit lach ki matnita. bea minneh: bishshel bemiktzat keli – taun merika ushetifa, o en taun? amar leh: eno taun, midde dehave ahazzaa.
Veha la tena hachi! amar leh: mistabbera keveged – ma beged eno taun kibbus ella mekom haddam, af keli eno taun merika ushetifa ella bimkom bishshul.
Amar leh: mi dame?! dam la mefapa, bishshul mefapa! veod, tanya: chomer behazzaa mimmerika ushetifa, vechomer bimrika ushetifa mibbehazzaa:
Chomer behazzaa – shehazzaa yeshnah bechattaot hachitzonot uvechattaot happenimiyyot, veyeshnah lifne zerika; ma sheen ken bimrika ushetifa.
Chomer bimrika ushetifa – shehammerika ushetifa noheget ben bekodshe kadashim ben bekadashim kallim, bishshel bemiktzat hakkeli – taun merika ushetifa kol hakkeli; ma sheen ken behazzaa.
Amar leh: i tanya tanya. vetama may? amar kera: "veim bichli nechoshet bushshala" – vaafillu bemiktzat keli.
Echad kodshe kodashim vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "chattat" – en li ella chattat, kol kadashim minnayin? talmud lomar: "kodesh kadashim hi".

Yachol sheani merabbe et hatteruma? talmud lomar: "otah" – perat litruma. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: kodshe kadashim teunin merika ushetifa, kadashim kallim enan teunin merika ushetifa. dichtiv: "kodesh kadashim" – kodshe kadashim en, kadashim kallim la.
May tama derabbi yehuda? middeitzterich "otah" lemaote teruma, mikkelal dekadashim kallim teunin merika ushetifa. verabbi shimon amar lach: "otah" kidamrinan.
Uteruma la baaya shetifa umerika?! vehatanya: kedera shebbishshel bah basar lo yevashshel bah chalav, veim bishshel – benoten taam. teruma lo yevashshel bah chullin, veim bishshel – benoten taam!
Amar abbaye, la tzericha ella lidamar mar: bishshel bemiktzat keli – taun merika ushetifa kol hakkeli. ha teruma – la tzerich ella mekom bishshul.
Rava amar, la tzericha ella lidamar mar: "bammayim" – velo beyayin, "bammayim" – velo bemazug. ha – afillu beyayin vaafillu bemazug.
Rabba bar ulla amar, la tzericha ella lidamar mar: merika ushetifa betzonen. ha – afillu bechammin.
Hanicha leman deamar: merika ushetifa betzonen; ella leman deamar: merika bechammin ushetifa betzonen – may ikka lememar? shetifa yattirta.

Mishna rabbi tarfon omer: bishshel mittechillat haregel – yevashshel bo kol haregel. vachachamim omrim: ad zeman achila. merika ushetifa – merika kimrikat hakkos, ushetifa kishtifat hakkos. merika ushetifa betzonen.

a: Hashshappud vehaaskala – magilan bechammin.
Gemara may tama derabbi tarfon? deamar kera: "ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha" – hakkatuv asaan lechullan boker echad.
Matkef la rav achadvuy bar amme: vechi en piggul baregel, veen notar baregel?!
Vechi tema hachi name; vehatanya, rabbi natan omer: lo amar rabbi tarfon ella zo bilvad!
Ella kidrav nachman amar rabba bar avu – deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: kol yom vayom naase giul lachavero.
Vachachamim omrim: ad zeman achila kulei. may kaamar? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: mamtin lah ad zeman achila, vahadar aved la merika ushetifa.

Menahane mille? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum abba yose ben abba: ketiv "umorak veshuttaf", uchetiv "kol zachar bakkohanim yochal". ha ketzad? mamtin lah ad zeman achila, vahadar aved la merika ushetifa.
Merika kimrikat hakkos, shetifa kishtifat hakkos. tanu rabbanan: merika ushetifa – betzonen. divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: merika bechammin, ushetifa betzonen.
May tama derabbanan? midde dehave aggiule goyim. verabbi amar lach: hageala la kaamena; ki kaamena – limrika ushetifa devatar hageala.
Verabbanan – im ken, lichtov kera o "morak morak" o "shuttaf shuttaf"; may "umorak veshuttaf"? shema minna: merika bechammin, ushetifa betzonen.
Verabbi – i ketiv "umorak morak", hava amena: tere zimne "morak", o tere zimne "shuttaf"; lechach ketiv "umorak veshuttaf", lomar lach: merika – kimrikat hakkos, shetifa – kishtifat hakkos.

Mishna bishshel bo kadashim vechullin, o kodshe kadashim vekadashim kallim; im yesh bahen benoten taam – hare hakkallim neechalin kachamurin shebbahen, veenan teunin merika ushetifa, veenan poslim bemagga.
Rakik shennaga berakik, vachaticha bachaticha – lo kol harkikin velo kol hachatichot asurin; eno asur ella bimkom shebbala.
Gemara may kaamar? im yesh bahen benoten taam – hare hakkallin neechalin kachamurin, uteunin merika ushetifa, ufoslin bemagga;
En bahen benoten taam – en hakkallin neechalin kachamurim, veen teunin merika ushetifa, veen poslin bemagga.
Nehi dekodshe kadashim la bau, kadashim kallim nive!
Amar abbaye: may "en teunin" dekaamar? kodshe kadashim. aval kadashim kallim – teunin. rava amar: ha manni – rabbi shimon hi, deamar: kadashim kallim en teunin merika ushetifa.
Bishlama lerava, hayeynu dekatane: o kodshe kadashim vekadashim kallim. ella leabbaye, tarte lema li?
Tzerichi; dei tena kadashim vechullin, hava amena: chullin hu dimvatteli kadashim, delav minnayyhu; aval kodshe kadashim vekadashim kallim – ema la.
Vei tena kodshe kadashim vekadashim kallim, hava amena: kadashim hu deallimi levattole kadashim, aval chullin – ema la; tzericha.
Rakik shehiggia berakik kulei. tanu rabbanan: "kol asher yigga" – yachol afillu shello bala? talmud lomar: "bivsarah" –
b: Ad sheyyibbala bivsarah.

Yachol naga bemiktzat chaticha yehe kullo pasul? talmud lomar: "yigga" – hannogea pasul. ha ketzad? chotech et makom shebbala. "bivsarah" – velo baggidin, velo baatzamot, velo bakkarnayim, velo battelafayim.
"Yikdash" – lihyot kamoha. ha ketzad? im pesula hi – tippasel, [veim] keshera hi – teachel kechamur shebbah.
Ammay? venete ase velidche et lo taase! amar rava: en ase doche et lo taase shebbammikdash,

Shenneemar: "veetzem lo tishberu vo". rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: echad etzem sheyyesh bo moach, veechad etzem sheen bo moach. ammay? nete ase velidche et lo taase! ella en ase doche lo taase shebbammikdash.
Rav ashe amar: "yikdash" ase hu, veen ase doche et lo taase vaase.
Ashkechan chattat demitkaddeshet bevillua, shear kadashim menalan? amar shemuel mishshum rabbi eliezer: "zot hattora laola velammincha velachattat velaasham velammilluim ulezevach hashshelamim".
"Laola" – ki ola; ma ola teuna keli, af kol teuna keli. may keli? ilema mizrak – beshalme tzibbur name ketiv behu: "vayyikkach moshe chatzi haddam vayyasem baagganot"!
Ella desakkin. veola gufa menalan? dichtiv: "vayyishlach avraham et yado vayyikkach et hammaachelet" – vehatam ola hu, dichtiv: "vayyaalehu leola tachat beno".
"Mincha" – ma mincha enah neechelet ella lezichre chehunna, af kol enam neechalin ella lezichre chehunna. may hi? i chattat veasham – behedya ketiv behu: "kol zachar bakkohanim yochlennu"!
Vei shalme tzibbur – meribbuyay dikra ate: "bekodesh hakkodashim tochlennu kol zachar yochal oto" – limmed al shalme tzibbur sheenan neechalin ella lezichre chehunna!
Tannae hi;

a: Ikka denafka leh mehacha, veikka denafka leh mehacha.
"Chattat" – ma chattat mitkaddeshet bevalua, af kol mitkaddeshet bevalua.
"Asham" – ma asham en shafir veshilya kadosh bo, af kol en shafir veshilya kadosh bo. kasavar: vavldot kadashim bahavayaytan hen kedoshim, vedanin efshar mishshei efshar.
"Milluim" – ma milluim motrehen bisrefa, veen baale chayyim bemotrehen; af kol – motrehen bisrefa, veen baale chayyim bemotrehen.
"Shelamim" – ma shelamim mefaggelin umitpaggelin, af kol mefaggelin umitpaggelin.
Bematnita tana mishshemeh derabbi akiva: "mincha" – ma mincha mitkaddeshet bevalua, af kol mitkaddeshet bevalua.

Veitzterich lemichtav mincha, veitzterich lemichtav chattat. dei ashmeinan mincha – deayyeyde derakkicha mibbala, aval chattat ema la; vei ashmeinan chattat – mishshum dekarir, aval mincha ema la; tzericha.

"Chattat" – ma chattat enah baa ella min hachullin, uvayyom, uveyado hayemanit; af kol enah baa ella min hachullin, uvayyom, uveyado hayemanit. vechattat menalan? amar rav chisda, amar kera: "vehikriv aharon et par hachattat asher lo" – mishshello, velo mishshel tzibbur velo mishshel maaser.
Bayyom – mibbeyom tzavvoto" nafka! kedi nasva.
Beyado hayemanit – midderabba bar bar chana nafka, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar resh lakish: kol makom shenneemar etzba uchehunna – eno ella yamin! kedi nasva.
Veibbaet ema: savar la kerabbi shimon, deamar: etzba – la baaya kehunna, kehunna – baaya etzba.
"Asham" – ma asham atzmotav muttarin, af kol atzmotav muttarin.
Amar rava: peshita li –
b: Dam chattat lematta vedam ola lemala, taun kibbus.
Bae rava: dam ola lematta vedam chattat lemala, mahu? mishshum nogea hu – veha nogea; o dilma mishshum balua hu – veha la bala (hu)? hadar pashta, deen teunin kibbus.
Amar rava: peshita li, dam al bigdo – chotzetz, veim tabbach hu – eno chotzetz. revav al bigdo – chotzetz, veim mocher revav hu – eno chotzetz. bae rava: dam urevav al bigdo, mahu?
Im tabbach hu, tippok li mishshum revav! vei mocher revav hu, tippok li mishshum dam! la tzericha, deaved ha veha. achada la kafed, attarte kafed; o dilma attarte name la kafed? teku.
Hadaran alach dam chattat
Mishna tevul yom umechussar kippurim – enan cholkin bakkodashim leechol laerev.
Onen – (eno) nogea veeno makriv, veeno cholek leechol laerev.
Baale mumin, ben baale mumin ovrin ben baale mumin kevuin – cholkin veochlin, aval lo makrivin.
Kol sheeno rauy laavoda – eno cholek babbasar. vechol sheen lo babbasar – en lo baorot.

Afillu tame bishat zerikat damim, vetahor bishat hekter chalavim – eno cholek babbasar; shenneemar: "hammakriv et dam hashshelamim [veet hachelev mibbene aharon] – lo (yihye) [tihye shok hayyamin lemana]".

a: Gemara mena hane mille? amar resh lakish, deamar kera: "hakkohen hamechatte otah yochlenna" – kohen hamechatte yochal, sheeno mechatte eno ochel.
Uchelala hu?! vahare mishmara kullah – deen mechattein, veochlin! rauy lechittuy kaamrinan.
Hare katan – deeno rauy lechittuy, veochel! ella may "yochlenna" – yechallekenna. rauy lechittuy – cholek, sheeno rauy lechittuy – eno cholek.
Hare baal mum – deeno rauy lechittuy, vecholek! baal mum rachamana rabbeyeh: "kol zachar bakkohanim" – lerabbot baal mum.
Veema: "kol zachar" – lerabbot tevul yom! mistabbera baal mum hava leh lerabboye, shekken ochel.
Adderabba – tevul yom hava leh lerabboye, dilureta michza chaze! hasheta miha ha la chaze.
Rav yosef amar: mikkede may "yochlenna" – yechallekenna; lichtov rachamana "yechallekenna"! may "yochlenna"? shema minna: rauy laachila – cholek, sheeno rauy laachila – eno cholek.
Bae resh lakish: baal mum vehu tame, mahu sheyyachleku lo? kevan dela chaze verachamana rabbeyeh – la shena, ma li tame ma li baal mum; o dilma, rauy laachila cholek, sheeno rauy laachila eno cholek?
Amar rabba, ta shema: kohen gadol makriv onen, veeno ochel, veeno cholek leechol laerev. shema minna: rauy laachila baenan! shema minna.
Bae rav oshaya: tame bekorbenot tzibbur, mahu sheyyachleku lo? mi amrinan: "hamechatte" amar rachamana – vehay name mechet hu; o dilma, rauy laachila cholek, sheen rauy laachila eno cholek?
Amar ravina, ta shema: kohen gadol makriv onen, veeno ochel, veeno cholek leechol laerev. shema minna: rauy laachila baenan! shema minna.
Onen nogea veeno makriv kulei. onen nogea?! ureminhi: onen umechussar kippurim – tzerichin tevila lakkodesh!
Amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: la kashya; kan beshettaval, kan beshello taval.
Vechi taval may have? ha hadra aleh aninut; deamar rabba bar rav huna: onen shettaval – aninuto chozeret alav!
La kashya; ha deassach dateh, ha dela assach dateh.
Hessach haddaat – shelishi ushevii bae; deamar rabbi yostay berabbi matun amar rabbi yochanan: hessach haddaat – tzarich hazzaa shelishi ushevii!
La kashya; ha deassach dateh mitteme met, ha deassach dateh mitteme sheretz.
Teme sheretz – tame mealleyay hu, heerev shemesh bae! veod, afillu teruma name!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: beomer nishmarti middavar hametammeeni, velo nishmarti middavar happosleni.
Umi ikka netiruta lefalga?! in; vehatanya: odehu hassal al rosho
