b: Umagrefa betocho, veamar: "libbi al hassal veen libbi al hammagrefa" – hassal tahor vehammagrefa temea.
Utetamme magrefa lesal! en keli metamme keli. utetamme ma shebbetocho! amar rava: beomer shemartiha middavar hametammeah, velo shemartiha middavar happoslah.
Iggalgal milleta, umetay lekammeh derabbi abba bar memel. amar lehu, la shemia lehu ha deamar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi: haochel shelishi shel teruma – asur leechol umuttar ligga?
Alma baachila avud rabbanan maala, bingia la avud rabbanan maala!
Veeno cholek leechol kulei. miflag hu dela pelig, vechi mezammeni leh – achel;
Ureminhi: onen (umechussar kippurim) – tovel veochel et pischo laerev, aval lo bekadashim!
Amar rav yirmeya middifti: la kashya; kan befesach, kan bishar yemot hashshana.
Befesach – ayyeyde deachel pesach, achel name kadashim. bishar yemot hashshana – dela chaze, la chaze. umay "aval lo bekadashim"? aval lo bekadashim shel kol hashshana.
Rav assi amar: la kashya; kan shemmet lo met bearbaa asar ukevaro bearbaa asar, kan shemmet lo met bishlosha asar ukevaro bearbaa asar; yom kevura la tafes lelo midderabbanan.

Man tanna aninut layla midderabbanan? rabbi shimon hi. detanya: aninut layla middivre tora. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: onen eno middivre tora, ella middivre sofrim. teda – shehare amru: onen tovel veochel et pischo laerev, aval lo bakkodashim.
Vesavar rabbi shimon aninut layla midderabbanan?! vehatanya, rabbi shimon omer: onen eno meshalleach korbenotav. may, lav vaafillu befesach? la; levar mippesach.
Vehatanya, rabbi shimon omer: "shelamim" – keshehu shalem mevi, veeno mevi keshehu onen. minnayin lerabbot et hattoda? merabbe ani et hattoda, shekken neechelet besimcha kishlamim.

Minnayin lerabbot et haola? merabbe ani et haola, shekken baa beneder uvindava kishlamim. minnayin lerabbot bechor umaaser vafesach? merabbe ani bechor umaaser vafesach, shekken enan bain al chet. minnayin lerabbot chattat veasham? talmud lomar: "zevach".
Minnayin lerabbot haofot vehammenachot vehayyayin vehaetzim vehallevona? talmud lomar: "shelamim korbano"; kol korbenot shehu mevi – keshehu shalem mevi, veeno mevi keshehu onen.
Katane miha pesach!
Amar rav chisda: pesach – kedi nasveh.
Rav sheshet amar: may pesach – shalme fesach. i hachi, hayeynu shelamim! tena shelamim habbain mechamat pesach, utena shelamim habbain mechamat atzman.
Dei la tena shelamim habbain mechamat pesach, salka datach amena: hoil umechamat pesach ate – kegufeh defesach dame; ka mashma lan.
Rav mari amar:

a: La kashya; kan shemmet lo met bearbaa asar ukevaro bearbaa asar, kan shemmet lo met bishlosha asar ukevaro bearbaa asar.
Met lo met bearbaa asar ukevaro bearbaa asar – yom mita tofes lelo middeorayyta. met lo met bishlosha asar ukevaro bearbaa asar – yom kevura midderabbanan, eno tofes lelo ella midderabbanan.

Amar leh rav ashe lerav mari: veella ha dekatane, amar lo rabbi shimon: teda, shehare amru: onen tovel veochel et pischo aval lo bakkodashim; nema leh: kaamena lach ana yom mita deorayyta, veamrat li et yom kevura derabbanan?! kashya.
Abbaye amar: la kashya; kan shemmet kodem chatzot, kan shemmet leachar chatzot. kodem chatzot, dela ichazi lefesach – chayyla aleh aninut. achar chatzot, deichazi lefesach – la chayyla aleh aninut.

Umena temra deshane leh ben kodem chatzot ben leachar chatzot? detanya: "lah yittamma" – mitzva. lo ratza – metammein oto al korcho. umaase beyosef hakkohen shemmeta ishto beerev happesach, velo ratza littamme, venimnu echav hakkohanim vetimmeuhu beal korcho.
Ureminhi: "velaachoto" ma talmud lomar? hare shehalach lishchot et pischo velamul et beno, veshama shemmet lo met – yachol yittamme? amarta lo yittamme.
Yachol keshem shello yittamme laachoto, kach en mittamme lemet mitzva? talmud lomar: "velaachoto" – laachoto hu deeno mittamme, aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva.
Lav shema minna: kan kodem chatzot, kan leachar chatzot?
Mimmay? dilma leolam ema lecha: idde veidde achar chatzot; veha rabbi yishmael veha rabbi akiva. detanya: "lah yittamma" – reshut. divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: chova.
La salka datach; deresha dehahi – rabbi akiva katane la. detanya, rabbi akiva omer: "nefesh" – ellu hakkerovim, "met" – ellu harchokim.

"Leaviv" eno mittamme, aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva. "leimmo" – haya kohen vehu nazir, leimmo hu deeno mittamme, aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva. "leachiv" – sheim haya kohen gadol vehu nazir, leachiv hu deeno mittamme, aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva.

"Velaachoto" ma talmud lomar? hare shehalach lishchot et pischo velamul et beno, veshama shemmet lo met – yachol yittamme? amarta: lo yittamme. yachol keshem sheen mittamme laachoto, kach eno mittamme lemet mitzva? talmud lomar: "velaachoto" – laachoto lo yittamme, aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva.
b: Rava amar: idde veidde achar chatzot, vela kashya; kan kodem sheshshachatu vezarku alav, kan leachar sheshshachatu vezarku alav.

Amar leh rav adda bar matna lerava: achar sheshshachatu vezarku et damo – ma dahava hava! amar leh ravina: achilat pesachim meakkeva, midderabba bar rav huna. amar leh: tzayet may dekaamar lach rabbach.
May derabba bar rav huna? detanya: yom shemua keyom kevura lemitzvat shiva usheloshim; velaachilat pesachim – keyom likkut atzamot. echad ze veechad ze – tovel veochel bakkodashim laerev.

Ha gufa kashya! amrat yom shemua keyom kevura lemitzvat shiva usheloshim, velaachilat pesachim keyom likkut atzamot – mikkelal deyom kevura afillu laerev name la achel; vahadar tane: echad ze veechad ze tovel veochel bakkodashim laerev!
Amar rav chisda: tannae hi.

Rabba bar rav huna amar: la kashya; kan sheshshama shemua al meto samuch lishkiat hachamma, vechen shellikketu lo atzamot samuch lishkiat hachamma, vechen shemmet lo met ukevaro samuch lishkiat hachamma; vechan leachar shekiat hachamma.
Leachar shekiat hachamma – may dahava hava! ella shema minna: achilat pesachim meakkeva.
Rav ashe amar: may echad ze veechad ze? hachi kaamar: echad yom shemua veechad yom likkut – tovel veochel bakkodashim laerev.
Veha derav ashe beduta hi; mikkede ala kae, "ze vaze" mibbee leh! ella shema minna beduta hi.
Umay tannae? detanya: ad matay mitonen alav? kol hayyom. rabbi omer: kol zeman shello nikbar.
Bemay askinan? ilema beyom mita – mi ikka delet leh deyom mita detafes lelo midderabbanan?!
Vetu, rabbi omer: kol zeman shello nikbar. ha kevaro – ishteri leh; umi ikka delet leh "veacharitah keyom mar"?!
Amar rav sheshet: ayyom kevura kae.

Matkef rav yosef, ella ha dekatane: hashshomea al meto – kimlakket atzamot, tovel veochel bakkodashim laerev; mikkelal deyom kevura – afillu laerev name la achel; ha manni? ella taretz: ad matay mitonnin alav? kol oto hayyom velelo. rabbi omer: kol zeman shello nikbar; [aval nikbar] – belo lelo.

Amruha kammeh derabbi yirmeya, amar: gavra rabba kerav yosef lema hachi?! lema derabbi lekulla?! vehatanya: ad matay mitonen alav? kol zeman sheeno nikbar, afillu mikkan vead asara yamim. divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: en mitonen alav ella oto hayyom bilvad!
Ella taretz hachi: ad matay hu mitonen alav? kol oto hayyom belo lelo. rabbi omer: kol zeman shello nikbar. veim nikbar – tofes lelo.
Amruha kammeh derava; middekaamar rabbi: yom kevura tofes lelo midderabbanan – mikkelal deyom mita tofes lelo middeorayyta;

Vesavar rabbi aninut layla deorayyta?! vehatanya: "hen hayyom" – ani hayyom asur velayla muttar, uledorot ben bayyom uven ballayla asur. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi omer: aninut layla enah middivre tora, ella middivre sofrim!
Leolam derabbanan hi,
